name: Azeroth Companion
title: ADAPTIVE EXPERIENCE ENGINE — Premium Cross-Studio Visuals & Performance
approval_note: Owner selected visual adaptive engine for next site release. Real-device and connected game/player checks pending.
features: NEXUS Adaptive Experience Engine: shared premium visual design for PROXIMUS Gateway, Asset Alchemist and primary Azeroth Companion studios, preserving each product's signature look.
Choose Auto, Cinematic, Balanced or Quiet in an accessible visual settings control; browser-local preference persists between compatible pages on the same host.
Auto responds to small touch viewports, Save-Data and operating-system reduced-motion preferences; reduced motion always takes precedence over optional decorative animation.
Refined lighting, accent borders, depth, and gentle desktop card hover, with quieter iPhone visual effects and strong keyboard focus.
Gateway's decorative star painter avoids drawing in Quiet mode, while the main companion reuses existing CSS/JS requests rather than adding startup files.

Entirely presentation-only: no changes to Blizzard login, characters, item collections, Talent Forge, saved expedition routes, music, media libraries, license bridges or application redirect protocols.
Source safety and synthetic desktop/iPhone browser audits accompany rollback and pending physical-player/device testing.
